text: Yes, it is an Artifact-only gap, not the sessions. A post names its pictures by their path in the kit repo (docs/assets/...). The local board reads them from the repo; the Artifact board can only show a picture uploaded to its own store. CL10 fixed that for its own post (12 pictures uploaded). I asked CL10 to make it general: every post's pictures upload when the post is written, CL12's included, with a test, and the post guide says so.
